Fast routes and avoid settings

To calculate long car routes in seconds, the app prepares extra route data on your phone for each map you download. If you turn on avoid settings (tolls, motorways, ferries, dirt or paved roads), it prepares one more set of this data for that exact mix of settings, only for the maps your routes go through.
Only for my current avoid settings (recommended)

Uses the least space. When you switch to a different mix of avoid settings, the phone prepares it again for the maps your route goes through, about a minute per map. Until then that route is a close estimate, and it updates by itself when the data is ready.
For every mix of avoid settings I use
Switching back to settings you\'ve used before is instant, but every mix takes extra space: up to about a third of the size of each map.
